_about: PostureProof.cs (-postureproof) steps (a) parry and (b) guard break. parryLeadFractions = how late in the enemy windup the player raises the guard, as a fraction of the parry window (parry.json windowTicks, via DuelFighter.ParryWindowTicks); one entry = one attempt. The guard SIDE is not data here: it is read from controls.json guard.match through DirectionalGuard.BestSideFor(the swing being answered). requireParry / requireGuardBreak = the verdict is FAIL (exit failExitCode) when that step did not happen (event AND the DuelFighter counter). All waits are 60 Hz sim ticks.
